evidence_scope: Managed source for three hosts; local command availability on Starship. Action paths were not exercised against live devices.

items.current_path: Select the Niri session at SDDM.
items.reference_path: Retain SDDM and the standalone neutral greeter; apply the selected UI typography and explicit cursor choice.
items.implementation_gap: Document the greeter and its system-owned theme, then align fonts/cursors.
items.hardware_variation: Physical login on each host; display scaling differs.
items.acceptance: Normal password login and wallet unlock, followed by ready session services.

items.current_path: Mod+H/J/K/L or arrows; Mod+R widths; Mod+O overview; native hotkey overlay.
items.reference_path: Retain the tested bindings, 4px gaps, square windows, fixed width presets and per-application rules.
items.implementation_gap: Present exact personal settings alongside separately labeled portable examples.
items.hardware_variation: Ultrawide versus laptop logical width.
items.acceptance: Move between Chrome and terminal, resize, change workspace, and return without losing the focused window.

items.task: Dock, undock and use readable displays
items.current_path: Shared internal/home/work/single/dual profiles start with Niri.
items.reference_path: Retain named output profiles and the current per-display scale/refresh selections.
items.implementation_gap: Document profile matching, fallback/recovery, and logical scaling; do not publish monitor serials.
items.hardware_variation: Starship ultrawide at scale 1; Carbon internal at 1.5; Snap internal/work/home profiles.
items.acceptance: Normal dock/undock and reconnect on applicable hosts, with a reachable session after each transition.

items.current_path: Mod+D opens drun.
items.reference_path: Keep drun as the common application entry; add discoverable desktop entries for the few utilities below.
items.implementation_gap: Utility entry naming and packaging need explicit management.
items.hardware_variation: Available applications differ by host.
items.acceptance: Search by task/name, activate, cancel, and inspect keyboard focus.

items.current_path: Chrome handles web/PDF; Dolphin handles directories; GTK portal handles file selection.
items.reference_path: Retain those roles, with coherent app fonts/icons/cursors and clear defaults.
items.implementation_gap: Document actual GTK/WLR/KWallet routing; verify chooser behavior and native app appearance.
items.hardware_variation: Portal and wallet behavior must be checked per session.
items.acceptance: Download a sample PDF/image, open it, choose a file to send, and follow Open with.

items.current_path: MIME defaults point to the selected native applications.
items.reference_path: Keep native viewers and archive handling as supporting desktop capabilities.
items.implementation_gap: Present the default-app map and check launch paths; avoid rebuilding viewer UIs.
items.hardware_variation: File types and codecs vary; common supported samples define acceptance.
items.acceptance: Open a sample image, short video, and archive from Dolphin; return to work.

items.current_path: Dolphin and udisksctl are available on Starship; a physical mount flow was not exercised.
items.reference_path: Use Dolphin for mount/unmount and ordinary file operations; retain native authorization.
items.implementation_gap: Make udisks2 an explicit dependency of this supported capability and verify the flow.
items.hardware_variation: Requires a disposable removable drive on the tested host.
items.acceptance: Mount, read/write a sample, safely unmount; no existing disk formatting or repartitioning.

items.task: Open terminals and return to agents
items.owner: Kitty / Zsh / Powerlevel10k / native providers / Agent Plus
items.current_path: Mod+Return/Mod+T opens Kitty with the managed Zsh prompt, history/completion, fzf/zoxide integrations; Mod+A returns to dedicated native TUI windows.
items.reference_path: Slate Blue terminal background/cursor/selection and ANSI palette; semantic prompt roles; portable Zsh core and optional development integrations. Native provider/editor RGB themes remain independently owned.
items.implementation_gap: Extract and attribute the shell core, pin upstream plugin/theme revisions, and qualify the generated appearance fragment before adoption.
items.hardware_variation: Provider availability and environments differ.
items.acceptance: Check isolated human/agent startup, prompt history/completion/status cleanup and absent hardware, then owned Kitty windows, input/glyphs, tmux/remote/full-screen tools and native focus/notifications.

items.task: Reach remote work and tmux sessions
items.current_path: Mod+S for SSH Plus; Mod+G for Tmux Plus.
items.reference_path: Retain their public launch contracts and directional host access.
items.implementation_gap: Document the workflow and link component guides; no new routes or automatic remote access.
items.hardware_variation: Configured endpoint reachability and installed tuples differ.
items.acceptance: Use an owned test endpoint/session, preserve filter/action behavior, and return to the intended session.

items.current_path: Mod+N displays primary-link state; nmtui and nmcli are available.
items.reference_path: Status remains in the panel. A Network desktop entry opens Kitty with nmtui.
items.implementation_gap: Add a managed desktop entry; record networkmanager as owner and verify reconnect flow.
items.hardware_variation: Wi-Fi, Ethernet and other primary links differ; credentials stay with native configuration.
items.acceptance: Inspect status and open the UI without changing the connection; test actual changes only in a suitable host window.

items.task: See devices, pair, connect or disconnect
items.current_path: Connected-device/battery status is in the panel; bluetoothctl is available on Starship.
items.reference_path: Keep the status card. A Bluetooth desktop entry opens a dedicated terminal running bluetoothctl, with a short pairing guide.
items.implementation_gap: Make bluez/bluez-utils and service ownership explicit for admitted hosts; add the entry and guide. No panel pairing UI is promised.
items.hardware_variation: No adapter, disconnected devices and missing battery values are normal states.
items.acceptance: Pair/connect/disconnect an owned peripheral without changing unrelated pairings or discoverability policy.

items.current_path: Hardware keys invoke the existing helper with 5% steps and replaceable feedback.
items.reference_path: Preserve the helper behavior and use the shared notification typography, colors and progress style.
items.implementation_gap: Bring the helper and its prerequisites into public reference material.
items.hardware_variation: Default input/output and mute state differ.
items.acceptance: Small bounded changes using owned audio context; microphone and speaker feedback stay distinct.

items.current_path: pavucontrol is installed on Starship; wpctl offers direct status and selection.
items.reference_path: Use pavucontrol as the common graphical Audio entry. Keep the Starship SwayNC per-app widget as its existing optional trial.
items.implementation_gap: Admit pavucontrol explicitly in the desktop baseline; do not infer that it is installed across the cohort.
items.hardware_variation: Headsets, HDMI, microphones and active streams differ.
items.acceptance: Select owned output/input and verify a browser-call/device-selection path; restore original choices.

items.current_path: Laptop brightness keys address the internal backlight; the helper is a no-op without one.
items.reference_path: Keep the internal-backlight path. External-monitor physical controls are the baseline; explicit DDC remains optional.
items.implementation_gap: Document this distinction and the helper. Do not imply DDC/backlight parity across all displays.
items.hardware_variation: External displays may lack usable DDC; keyboard LEDs are separate.
items.acceptance: Make a small internal-backlight change and restore it; test DDC only on a named supported monitor.

items.current_path: Mod+Y; Enter copies, Delete removes, Ctrl+Shift+Delete confirms clearing.
items.reference_path: Retain original-byte restoration, 200-entry retention, session-scoped collection and shared Rofi appearance.
items.implementation_gap: Capture the real text/image workflow after theme adoption.
items.hardware_variation: No history and image rows are normal states.
items.acceptance: Use disposable text/image entries; verify restore, delete and cancellation without clearing unrelated history.

items.current_path: Print/Alt+Print/Ctrl+Print for native captures; managed portal capture uses WLR.
items.reference_path: Retain native screenshot keys. Record and qualify the actual WLR sharing profile before changing its backend.
items.implementation_gap: Browser sharing and permission/stop behavior need real-session acceptance. The generic GNOME example is a separate adaptation.
items.hardware_variation: Available share targets depend on the portal path and compositor.
items.acceptance: Capture owned sample windows and verify a browser-call sharing flow using nonprivate content.

items.task: See alerts, act, and control interruption
items.current_path: Mod+N; history, DND, native dashboard and originating-application actions.
items.reference_path: Keep panel cards and freshness/lifetime behavior. Unify owned shell styling and retain separate transient hardware feedback.
items.implementation_gap: Record exact personal panel appearance and public fork recipe, including hardware limits.
items.hardware_variation: Battery/GPU/Bluetooth cards hide or show according to actual capability.
items.acceptance: Normal/critical/transient notification handling, origin focus, DND, fresh reopen and hidden-card return.

items.current_path: Dashboard charge/state/rate/ETA and captured per-host display/suspend policy.
items.reference_path: Keep current policy: display off 10 min, battery suspend 30 min, no automatic lock or AC suspend, no lock-before-suspend.
items.implementation_gap: Document personal choices, prerequisites and inhibitors; no security/power policy change in a visual pass.
items.hardware_variation: No battery on desktop; charge limits and rates differ; ETA may be unavailable.
items.acceptance: Check AC/battery transitions, known/unknown rates and limits, normal-use inhibition and later suspend/resume.

items.current_path: powerprofilesctl is available through terminal/agent workflows.
items.reference_path: Keep the explicit CLI path in the guide; no new persistent widget is required.
items.implementation_gap: Document supported-profile discovery; do not expose unavailable profiles as working controls.
items.hardware_variation: Profile support depends on platform/driver.
items.acceptance: Read available profiles first; any actual trial must restore the prior profile.

items.task: Lock, log out, suspend, restart or shut down
items.owner: Gtklock / Niri / logind / proposed Rofi session menu
items.current_path: Ctrl+Alt+Delete and loginctl requests use the lock service; Mod+Shift+E quits Niri; terminal commands cover other actions.
items.reference_path: Retain manual lock and native Niri quit behavior. Add a small Session desktop entry for explicit Lock/Logout/Suspend/Restart/Shut down actions.
items.implementation_gap: One bounded Rofi helper is proposed. Confirm restart/shutdown, reuse native quit confirmation, preserve existing suspend policy and native authorization.
items.hardware_variation: Lid/AC/lock choices remain host-owned; active work must be preserved during testing.
items.acceptance: First test cancellation and command dispatch in isolation; live lock/logout/suspend/restart only in scheduled acceptance.

items.task: Switch languages and read candidate text
items.current_path: Mod+Space switches input; Wayland fractional-scale support is configured.
items.reference_path: Retain input engines and switching; align UI font/fallback/cursor and verify candidate-window appearance.
items.implementation_gap: Specify UI/CJK fallbacks without importing private dictionaries/history; visually test Chrome and terminals.
items.hardware_variation: Physical keyboard layout, IME engines and scale differ.
items.acceptance: Type disposable English/CJK samples in browser and terminal; verify preedit, candidate selection and cancellation.

items.task: Authorize changes and use existing secrets
items.current_path: Session-owned agent waits for the captured Wayland socket; wallet/PAM integration is retained.
items.reference_path: Keep native authorization and secrets ownership; align supported app style/font and preserve authentication behavior.
items.implementation_gap: Document the boundary and inspect appearance without changing PAM, wallet backend or account state.
items.hardware_variation: Normal password-login and wallet behavior require per-host acceptance.
items.acceptance: Use a harmless owned authorization prompt and normal login; never record credentials.
